assumptions.description: Exactly 375 rows in each sex by age-band cell. Integer age is independent discrete uniform within its target band. Cells and the fictional records have no national sampling weights.

The post-selection conditional law is transported from external populations to the task population without numerical ancestry, serum/plasma, assay, fasting-duration or medication/anemia corrections. These differences are unassessed; no actual diagnosis, pregnancy/lactation, fasting or anthropometry documentation is recovered.

Independent standardized symmetric Beta(4,4) residuals have support [-3,3]. This is an explicit smooth bounded residual choice; its BMI and glucose support limits are technical modeling restrictions, not known clinical or population cutoffs.

BMI and glucose are independent of age and sex, with residual Pearson correlation 0.25 from a shared beta factor. The unreported correlations with age/sex and zero sex coefficient are completion assumptions, not zero facts. The value 0.25 is a chosen structural scenario, not estimated evidence.

HbA1c has the additive identity-scale conditional mean specified by the model, independent homoscedastic beta residual and no interactions. The two Jansen coefficients are constraints on separate projections; their joint coefficients are solved using A_BG.

Lifelines source context: continuous age=55.5+9.9*U_A, U_A standardized Beta(4,4); female Bernoulli(0.597), independent of all factors. BMI/glucose law is the same as the target. Table1 margins are assumed applicable to Table2 row-specific analysis populations despite unresolved row n. All exclusion conditions are represented as conditioning labels; their selection process is not reconstructed.

Pani source context: age=25+Gamma(shape=4,scale=7.5 years), with unbounded upper age support, female Bernoulli(0.5), independent of the same BMI/glucose factors. This is an assumed survey-population law, not the unavailable complex-survey design. The common Lifelines HbA1c intercept and conditional law are transferred for a deliberately visible source compatibility check. None of these source age probabilities is taken from unweighted counts.

Pani adjusted age coefficient 0.01 percentage point/year is treated as the common conditional age coefficient. The linear mean with full-rank covariates makes this the adjusted population projection under each declared source age law, but does not reproduce source survey estimation or establish causal aging.

Use the directly printed Jansen percent HbA1c mean 5.6 and SD 0.3 as level and total-variance anchors. Do not add the alternate IFCC-derived rounded representation as independent evidence. BMI and glucose marginal means/SDs are transported unchanged; the age distribution follows task design.

External estimates are fixed plug-in point constraints. Unknown slope SE/CI level and row n prohibit inverse-variance pooling. Jansen printed bounds retain unknown confidence level. Pani band SE is estimate precision, never individual SD. Seed variation is residual/finite-sample variability, not source-estimate or transport uncertainty.

Source-law algebra is qualified and not source replay. Actual target-table-to-source comparisons are unavailable. The Pani age-band diagnostics may disagree with evidence and are retained, not tuned away.

design.derivation: Task quotas and support; the record prefix only identifies fictional rows.

factor_law.derivation: Chosen symmetric bounded residual family and unreported dependence scenario.

anchors.derivation: Printed percent representation chosen; glucose conversion uses admitted factor 18, without conversion of FPG into eAG.

source_projection_constraints.derivation: Jansen slope conversion is scale-only 0.13*0.09148 and 2.29*0.09148/18. The three quantities are separate population projections.

conditional_coefficients.derivation: Solve bB+rho*sG/sB*bG=sB_source and bG+rho*sB/sG*bB=sG_source. Set age coefficient to Pani adjusted projection; sex coefficient zero is assumed. See analytic/source_algebra.py and results.json.

source_contexts.derivation: Lifelines age mean/SD and sex proportion are admitted; source age shapes and all Pani age/sex law parameters are explicit completion assumptions.
